Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — following up from our platform review last week. We need a small, self-serve view in the Console that our ops and finance folks can use daily: a single tenant-level "health ledger" that shows at-a-glance cost and latency signals and lets us drill to the top offending routes.

I attached a tiny template that shows the export columns we need (monthly-usage-request-template.csv). Budget holder wants this before their next billing review on Aug 2. Can your product/metrics team confirm feasibility and an ETA for a basic tile (read-only) + CSV export?

Thanks Ben / Amanda — quick product writeup below. I attached a wireframe (tenant-health-wireframe.png) to make the idea concrete.

Proposed minimum viable tile (read-only)
- Header: Tenant name + month-to-date cost + day-over-day delta
- Top row metrics: Today cost, 30d cost, P50 latency, P95 latency, errors %
- Charting: 7d stacked area by model (cost) + overlay P95 line
- Drilldown: click tenant -> top 5 routes by cost and top 5 routes by P95 latency (table with small sparkline)
- Export: CSV export button with the columns in Amanda's template; include a utc timestamp and a note about the time window
- Alerts: simple rule builder (preset: P95 > 1s for 10m; preset: cost delta > 30% over 24h). When triggered, we surface in Console and POST to a webhook.

Operational considerations / questions for infra:
- Do we have a 5-min pre-aggregation pipeline for per-route P95 that can be queried per-tenant without scanning raw events? If not, we should plan a rollup job.
- Privacy: export must honor retention filters / subtenant scrubbing for masked tokens (we should gate export for customers on strict retention settings).
- Feature flag: roll out to a subset of tenants (early access) before enabling broadly.

Rollout asks / timeline (hypothesis)
- 1 sprint: wireframe + backend contract + sample export (read-only)
- 2-3 sprints: pre-aggregation + endpoint for tile data + export endpoint
- 1 sprint: UI polish + feature-flag rollout + docs

Amanda — would the early-access tile + export be acceptable while we harden alerts? If yes, we can aim for a limited rollout in ~6 weeks from signoff.

Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Console
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Visibility ask: per-tenant health + cost export

Thanks — good summary. Technical constraints and proposal from infra:

Constraints:
- We don’t currently store per-route P95 at arbitrary cardinality; computing P95 on raw traces for many tenants is expensive and will blow query costs if done ad-hoc for exports
- Cost breakdown by model + route is available if we attribute tokens at ingestion, but "token-path" granularity requires augmenting our ingest schema to carry call_idx and route labels for aggregations

Proposal (practical, lowest-effort path):
1) Implement 5-min rollups that materialize: total_tokens, total_cost_estimate, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms per (tenant, route, model) — 5-min granularity will give tight enough visibility for the Console and cheap queries
2) Export endpoint reads from rollups (no scan of raw data) and supports backfill for the prior 90 days from the rollups if we bootstrap historic rollups job (costly, opt-in per account)
3) Alerts run against rollups + a small anomaly detector (moving-window percent delta). Alert notifications will be Console + webhook; if a customer wants incident creation we emit to PagerDuty via configured integration.

Effort estimate: initial rollup ingestion + API (~3-4 sprint backend), UI tile + export (~2 sprints), tuning + docs (~1 sprint). Total: ~6-7 sprints for a robust GA; 3 sprints for an EA with limited window/backfill.

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm EA fields and whether we gate backfill as a paid add-on (helps prioritize)
- Ben: coordinate with Amanda on whether EA (3-sprint) timeline is acceptable and whether Acme will opt into backfill (I can prioritize their account if they do)
- I attached implementation-notes.md and a small ZIP with example evidence from their spike (sla-exception-evidence.zip) that illustrates the shape of queries we saw last month. Amanda — if you can confirm the historical window you care about and whether incident creation is required, we’ll slot this into infra capacity planning.

- karthik
